title: fix(plugin-dashboard): a dataset widget labels its comparison from compareTo.kind, not the filter's macro tokens (objectui#11632)
body:
Fixes #11632

Clause-②: no

## What changed

On the ADR-0021 dataset path, `DatasetWidget` now names a comparison window from `compareTo.kind` alone. `previousPeriod` reads "vs previous period" and `previousYear` reads "vs last year". It no longer calls `compareToTrendLabelKey`, which guesses the window from the RAW filter's date-macro tokens (`{today}` gives "vs yesterday", quarter macros give "vs last quarter").

A module-local `COMPARE_KIND_TREND_KEY` maps each kind to its existing `dashboard.trend.*` key. It is typed with `satisfies` against a Record keyed by `CompareToConfig['kind']`, so a third kind added to that type is a compile error there. `TREND_LABEL_DEFAULTS` is unchanged: it stays the vocabulary `check:i18n-keys` reads for the `dashboard.trend.` family.

`compareToTrendLabelKey` in `@object-ui/core` and the inline path that uses it are unchanged, per triage's direction.

## Why the guess was wrong here and right inline

On the inline path, `shiftFilterByCompareTo` really does rewrite the filter (`{today}` becomes `{yesterday}`, `current_*` becomes `last_*`), so a label read off those tokens names what was queried. On the dataset path no token is rewritten. The widget lowers the resolved window into `timeDimensions[].dateRange`, and the executor's `shiftRange` (objectstack `service-analytics`, `dataset-executor.ts`, read at objectstack `07bf21ff`) moves the whole window. `previousPeriod` becomes the equal-length window ending the day before, and `previousYear` the same window a year back. The kind is all there is to know about which window was compared, so the label comes from the kind.

## Every surface this label reaches

The fix changes one call. Its result, `compareLabel`, is the only window label in `DatasetWidget`, and every comparison surface reads it: the KPI delta (`dataset-compare-trend`), the flat table's comparison column header and its CSV export header, the cross-tab caption and cell title, and the chart's comparison series label (the line legend in the card). None of them needs a change of its own.

Other callers of `compareToTrendLabelKey`, none of them changed:

- `ObjectMetricWidget`: the inline object metric. It compares through `shiftFilterByCompareTo`, so its label is faithful there.
- `ObjectChart` (`plugin-charts`): its comparison series is built only for an `aggregate` chart on the inline path. Its dataset branch forwards no `compareTo` to `queryDataset`, so the label call never runs for a dataset-bound chart. See Acceptance notes.

## "And the resolved window": what the window would add, and why the kind is enough

The card's Done-when names "the compareTo kind and the resolved window". The kind decides the window: for every window, `previousPeriod` is "the equal-length window before it". So "vs previous period" is true of a 30-day range, a quarter and a single day alike, and the window adds no correctness to the label. What it could add is specificity, in one of two ways:

- **The length** ("vs previous 30 days"). This needs a new interpolated `dashboard.trend.*` key in ten locales. That is outside this dispatch's Clause-② fence (no new i18n key).
- **A calendar name** when the shifted window happens to coincide with one. A 7-day Monday-to-Sunday window shifted back is "last week". Q4 shifted back 92 days is Q3, but Q1 (90 days) shifted back starts on 3 October, so the name holds only sometimes. Deciding when would re-derive the executor's `shiftRange` arithmetic in the renderer: a second copy of the producer's logic, which can drift from it.

Neither is needed for a faithful label, so this PR takes the kind. The report raises it as an open question so the Done-when reading is confirmed rather than assumed.

## Tests

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.compareTo.test.tsx`:

- **Replaced** the pin `labels the window from the RAW filter's macros, which resolution erased`. It asserted the removed branch: `previousPeriod` over quarter macros reading "vs last quarter" on the dataset path. That label is wrong there, because the executor compares the equal-length window, not the calendar quarter.
- **Added** a block named `the comparison label comes from compareTo.kind (objectui#11632)`, using the card's shape (a dashboard `last_30_days` range, `{30_days_ago}` to `{today}`):
  - `previousPeriod` reads "vs previous period" and not "yesterday" on the KPI delta. The whole resolved window is lowered for the executor to shift.
  - The chart's comparison series (the line legend) reads the same.
  - `previousPeriod` over quarter macros reads "vs previous period", with no calendar unit.
  - Each kind `@objectstack/spec` declares for a widget's `compareTo` gets its own label. The kinds are read from `DashboardWidgetSchema` itself, and a coverage test fails if the spec gains a kind this table lacks.
- The inline path's existing pins stay unchanged and green: `compareToTrendLabelKey`'s `{today}` gives `vsYesterday` in `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/compare-to.test.ts`, and `ObjectMetricWidget.compareTo`'s "labels vs last quarter".

## Reverse verification (one-off, from committed state)

`DatasetWidget.tsx` was reverted to the base commit `76993f8`. The blob hash matched the base blob. `COMPARE_KIND_TREND_KEY` counted 0, and the old `compareToTrendLabelKey(compareTo, rawFilter)` call counted 1. A trap then restored HEAD, and the restore was proved by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- HEAD `95f2df9`: `Tests 31 passed (31)`.
- Reverted: `Tests 4 failed | 27 passed (31)`, all four in the new block. The failures received "Revenue · vs yesterday", "20%vs yesterday" and "20%vs last quarter".
- The previousYear case and the spec-coverage case stay green, as expected: `previousYear` was already labelled by its kind.

## Live before/after

The live run used objectstack `main` `07bf21ff` (showcase, `objectstack dev --fresh`, own port) and the card's probe dashboard: a `last_30_days` date range on `created_at`, a `previousPeriod` metric, a `previousYear` metric and a `previousPeriod` line over `showcase_task_metrics`. Two consoles were served from source and pointed at that one backend.

| console | previousPeriod KPI | previousYear KPI | line legend |
|---|---|---|---|
| base `76993f8` | `800%` vs yesterday | `100%` vs last year | Tasks · vs yesterday |
| this branch | `800%` vs previous period | `100%` vs last year | Tasks · vs previous period |

Both consoles sent identical dataset queries: `timeDimensions` `created_at` `["2026-09-05","2026-10-05"]` with the `compareTo` kind, and nothing else. The server answered `task_count 9`, `task_count__compare 1`.

A discriminating probe on the same server shows the executor compares the preceding window, not yesterday. The 8-day window `2026-09-28..2026-10-05` with `previousPeriod` answered `task_count 4`, `task_count__compare 3`. Queried alone, `2026-09-20..2026-09-27` counts 3 and yesterday (`2026-10-04`) counts 1.

## Gates (HEAD `95f2df9`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/compare-to.test.ts`: `Test Files 171 passed (171)`, `Tests 1699 passed | 6 skipped (1705)`.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' build` (the dependency closure, 13 packages): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard lint`: exit 0, 0 errors. No warning falls on a line this PR touches.
- Exit 0 on each of: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (no `dashboard.trend.*` key reported), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- `origin/main` was still at the base `76993f8` before this PR opened. The `origin/main` merge was a no-op ("Already up to date"), so the runs above are of the tree that would have resulted.

Changeset: `.changeset/11632-dataset-compare-label.md`, a `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`.

## Acceptance notes

These are read-only observations. Neither has been run through a public door, so neither is carded.

- **The inline `previousPeriod` over a rolling range.** `shiftFilterByCompareTo` rewrites `{today}` to `{yesterday}` but leaves `{30_days_ago}` alone. Over a `last_30_days` filter, the inline comparison window is therefore 30 days ago to yesterday. That window overlaps the current one almost entirely, and it is labelled "vs yesterday". The label is faithful to the rewrite, but the window is not "the equal-length window before", which is what `CompareToConfig`'s docblock and the spec's `DatasetCompareTo` describe for `previousPeriod`. This PR leaves the inline path alone, per triage. No one carries this.
- **A dataset-bound `ObjectChart` with `compareTo`.** Its dataset branch sends no `compareTo` to `queryDataset`, and it builds the comparison series only for an `aggregate` chart. Read from source, a `chart` block bound to a dataset with `compareTo` would draw no comparison and say nothing. No producer of that shape was looked for. No one carries this.
